title: Signal: MD5 use via hashlib.md5 (python) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the hashlib.md5 call in python code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches any hashlib.md5 call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
fpNotes: Deduplication, etag, and cache-key checksums are the common false positives; they need only a justifying comment.
